scope: Proposition 7.2 (Decay throughout the auxiliary family) of the manuscript “A power saving for intersective polynomial differences with an exponent depending only on the degree” (preprints/A-power-saving-for-intersective-polynomial-differences-with-an-exponent-depending-only-on-the-degree-October-5-2026/power-saving-intersective-polynomial-differences.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 182 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d69e417ac953581d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 44. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are constants a0, b0 > 0 and C0 ≥ 1, depending only on the fixed polynomial h, its chosen roots, and the fixed structural choices, such that for all positive integers l, N, Yl(N) ≤ C0lb0 N−a0 . (7.7) The exponents a0, b0 can be chosen as functions only of the structural parameters k, ζ, σ, M0, ρ∗. If the chosen roots of h satisfy Condition (U) and the choices depending only on k from Sections 2 and 3 are used, then a0, b0, d depend only on k, while C0 may still depend on the fixed data.
